name: Model Desk
description: The AI model market as a local data pipeline: every provider's prices, limits and capabilities from the open model catalog, checked, matched to their underlying models and kept as a change log and price history in DuckDB, with open-weights licences, access and a self-host floor.
author: Vakyartha

web__fetch_page.reason: Read the open model catalog's price and model documents once a day and when you press Refresh, and, each hour while Keep running is on, the weights host's access, licence and size for the open-weights models the catalog links to.
